caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a brass door handle or knocker, centered on a plain, off-white or beige background. The handle is vertically oriented and attached to two identical circular mounting plates, one at the top and one at the bottom, both featuring concentric circular patterns. The handle itself is depicted in shades of gold, yellow, and brown, with careful shading and highlights to indicate a metallic, reflective surface. The handle has a curved, elongated form with bulbous sections at both ends and a smaller rounded element in the middle. The lines and shading suggest a three-dimensional, solid metallic object. The door handle is placed within a simple fine rectangular border, and there is a signature at the lower right inside the border.
title: Door Knocker
